outcome.status.rationale: The closed completion or block status must match.

outcome.decision.rationale: Allow paraphrase while requiring the same packet, gate, and serial-tail decision.

outcome.evidence.rationale: Allow prose variance only when the cited workflow evidence supports the same result.

routing.atomicity_route.rationale: Both clients must consume the same authoritative route from the same staged topology.

routing.layer_status.rationale: Both clients must consume an independently correct current planner envelope before comparison.

routing.increment_count.rationale: The two independent additive increments are a closed fixture fact.

verification.command.rationale: Both clients execute the declared INTEGRATION_TEST command through the runner.

verification.status.rationale: Both clients must report the same truthful current execution outcome.
